title: LLMs vs. Traditional Sentiment Tools in Psychology: An Evaluation on Belgian-Dutch Narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing sentiment analysis performance (correlation with self-reported valence and response coverage) of Dutch-tuned LLMs against traditional lexicon-based tools on a dataset of spontaneous, low-resource Flemish (Belgian-Dutch) narratives to demonstrate English-centric and high-resource language training bias.

Evaluating the performance degradation of LLMs trained predominantly on formal corpora (legal documents, formal social media) when applied to colloquial, first-person narratives containing everyday emotional expressions and regional vocabulary.
